text.p: A prominent Ukrainian member of parliament, reputed to be one of the richest people in the former Soviet republic, was shot dead on Sunday in the city of Donetsk, police sources said.
Yevhen Shcherban was gunned down near the VIP section of Donetsk airport in eastern Ukraine by three men dressed in police uniform and armed with automatic rifles, they said.
Shcherban's wife was also shot and died on the way to hospital. At least one other person, who was not identified, was also killed and three of Shcherban's aids were wounded, the sources said.
The three gunmen escaped in a car which was later found abandoned outside Donetsk.
Shcherban was a well-known tycoon and the owner of Aton corporation, a wealthy trading company.

In other crimes in recent weeks Viktor Semenyov, Mayor of the Black Sea port of Sevastopol, was wounded by unknown gunman. The former speaker of the Crimean parliament, Yevhen Suprunyuk, was kidnapped in August but latyer escaped.

Interfax-Ukraine news agency said some Ukrainian media had linked Shcherban with an assassination attempt on Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko last July, when an explosion damaged a car taking Lazarenko to Kiev airport but he was unhurt. Shcherban had denied the accusations

"Some Ukrainian media had indirectly accused Yevhen Shcherban of involvement in an attempt on Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko's life," the agency said. "Shcherban denied such accusations several times."
